name: sotto
description: Full-duplex voice conversation with your running Claude Code session, powered by OpenAI gpt-live-1. Toggle with /talk.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: GPT-Live voice used for new voice sessions.

port.title: Local port
port.description: Loopback port for the sotto daemon and voice window.

idle_seconds.title: Idle seconds
idle_seconds.description: Close the paid voice session after this many seconds with no speech and no pending request; it wakes again when you talk (0 = never).

idle_minutes.title: Idle minutes (legacy)
idle_minutes.description: Legacy setting, used only when Idle seconds is not set.

wake_sensitivity.title: Wake sensitivity
wake_sensitivity.description: How readily your voice wakes a sleeping session (detected locally, nothing is sent until then). off = press Space to resume.

speaking_policy.title: Speaking policy
speaking_policy.description: How much the voice narrates Claude's work you did not ask about.

daily_cap_minutes.title: Daily cap (minutes)
daily_cap_minutes.description: Maximum voice minutes per day at $0.05/min (0 = no cap).

window.title: Voice window
window.description: Where the voice page opens: auto (the Sotto desktop app on macOS, else Chrome), app, chrome, or default (your default browser).

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to add the key in the voice window on first use (it is saved in your macOS Keychain). Needs access to gpt-live-1. An OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable, a .env file or the Keychain key takes precedence.

mirror.title: Mirror speech to Claude
mirror.description: What you say to the voice that it does not hand to Claude still reaches Claude a few seconds later as background: all (everything but filler), decisions (only decisions, feedback and requests), or off.

echo_guard.title: Echo guard
echo_guard.description: Keeps the voice from hearing itself on speakers. auto: a soft echo suppressor turns on only when the voice window measures echo that the browser's echo cancellation left behind (you can still talk over the voice); on: always; off: never. Headphones never need it.
